scope: Independent direct reading of all original retained chapter paragraphs, canonical spec/research, every case/fixture plan, source locators/payload pins, and relevant Simpler/rack/native-selection canonical boundaries. Approval concerns a conditional documentary analyst draft, not runtime outcomes or handoff release.

findings.problem: The canonical requirement correctly links both resequencing-slices and using-effects-on-slices. Its machine-readable row retains only resequencing-slices even though the body also describes per-chain and grouped effects. A reader treating that anchor as exhaustive would miss the sibling evidence.
findings.requested_change: When revising the packet, retain both anchors in machine-readable requirement evidence and route ATM014 to the effects section, or label the single field as only a primary locator and preserve the complete list separately. Canonical text/source support is already correct; this does not block partial analyst approval.

semantic_boundaries.command_eligibility: One applicable selected audio clip exposes the four documented commands; MIDI/multiselection/frozen/take-lane and other unsupported contexts stayU.
semantic_boundaries.slice_plan_count: The manual refuses a chosen Slice plan over128. The spec deliberately does not import its contextual rack-cap explanation as a general rack limit or a Convert-recognition note cap. First/last/counting/boundary rules remainU.
semantic_boundaries.preset_and_warp_timing: Supplied/UserLibrary Defaults templates and Preserve warped timing are documented choices; exact mapping/default/rounding/resampling/audio equality remainU.
semantic_boundaries.result_correspondence: New track/clip and one chromatically ordered note/DrumRack chain/Simpler per independently established source slice are documented. Exact starting MIDI pitch, velocity, note length and media representation stayU.
semantic_boundaries.macro_and_effects: Observable mapped control changes, order editing and per-chain/subgroup effect placement are distinguished from unknown mapping curves and effect waveforms. Generic rack/MIDI/device algorithms remain with their canonical owners.
semantic_boundaries.recognition: Harmony uses polyphonic pitched input and piano-sound InstrumentRack; Melody uses monophonic input and synthesizer InstrumentRack/Synth to Piano macro; Drums attempts kick/snare/hihat classification into DrumRack. Recognition resynthesizes notes rather than replaying original audio. No exact notes/keys/velocity/accuracy/tuning/threshold/timing or preset/DSP identity is inferred.
semantic_boundaries.transients_and_quality: Marker influence is documented for Convert, while clear attacks/isolated/uncompressed material are recommendations. Wrong-class or lossy inputs have no perfect-accuracy oracle.
semantic_boundaries.native_selection: Existing x86-live-paths research distinguishes Harmony/Melody versus Drums task selection. This packet links it as research context and mandates no internal task/ABI/model.
semantic_boundaries.simpler_context: Simpler017 owns instrument-context conversion; this packet owns audio-clip dialog workflows and does not merge their state/source/selection preconditions.

fixture_preconditions.F1: Nonempty retained audio source and selection/state metadata; Warp comparison explicitly needs independently established nonidentity timing and fixed boundaries.
fixture_preconditions.F2: Four/129-region plans are independent prerequisites requiring target/source corroboration before executable use, never counts inferred from candidate output. Distinguishable nonzero slices and independently active/nonmuted instrument/output path are required for playback.
fixture_preconditions.F3: Compatible retained templates, independently known macro associations and supported control domains are prerequisites; no template asset or parser behavior is fabricated.
fixture_preconditions.F4: Finite independently valid pitched/percussive inputs and annotations establish input truth only; annotations are never recognizer expected notes.
fixture_preconditions.missing_prerequisite_result: U/unexecuted; no completed fixture or target output is claimed.

remaining_limitations: All29 case definitions remain targetU and not-run. Nine verified payloads and documentary predicates are not application compatibility evidence.

No actual input audio, slicing template, independently corroborated4/129 plan, generated MIDI/rack reference or audio output is supplied. Future executable scenarios must establish those fixtures and nondegenerate active macro/control ranges independently.
Several cases inspect structural availability or documentary influence only; they do not close recognition accuracy, piano/synth sound identity, exact timing or complete behavior of every subclause.

Pitch/onset/classifier algorithms, numeric thresholds/velocity/key/rate/tuning, count/marker arithmetic, determinism, source preservation/result placement/routing, timing during edits, undo/redo, cancellation, malformed/error/resource handling, persistence/collect/missing-media and teardown remainU. No conversion, device or file family is complete.
